### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[P-Section]: List each distinct plan item only once. If an action or appointment is mentioned multiple times but refers to the same event, record it as a single item in the plan.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Include only physical examination findings explicitly stated by the provider. Do not infer or add examinations not mentioned in the transcript. Differentiate between patient-reported symptoms (Review of Systems) and provider-observed physical exam findings.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Ground all contributing factors and causal links strictly to explicit statements or direct implications made by the provider in the transcript. Do not infer unstated causal relationships between lifestyle factors and symptoms.
